title: the outside review's fixes, checked and written anew
note: basis 'shown' means shown on master by the card's unit test (H137-01 to H137-10), by a probe in a session container (H137-11, H137-14) or by reading the code (H137-12, H137-15, H137-16); H137-13 was not run. H137-02 is High on the integrator's ruling 7147065106. H137-11 and H137-12 are built on the owner's decisions (#639 7156806411 items 6 and 7) and shown by tests/unit/test_mail_tls_verified.py, tests/unit/test_trusted_proxy_list.py and V3-01's test.

findings.claim: model_guard read the first of two Content-Length headers and forwarded the last, so an unkeyed request's body could carry a second request the model server ran with no key
the EDC OIDC issuer signed and accepted tokens under an empty HMAC key when TB_EDC_OIDC=1 and the client secret was empty
an EDC event signature header with non-ASCII text raised in hmac.compare_digest (a 500, not a refusal)
REDCAP_TOKEN_<ref> overrode TB_REDCAP_TOKEN_<ref> and TB_REDCAP_PROJECT_TOKENS, against docs/data/13 (the shorter name only when the TB_ one is empty)
the EDC link map was created 0644 and chmodded after, and rewritten in place: a failed write left the saved map torn, read back as empty
the prefill quote check stripped an integer's trailing zeros: 70 was shown by a quote saying 7, 100 by 1, 0 by any quote
the adapter's /publish and /$validate joined the snapshot name to the lake unchecked: .., ../outside and a/b reached folders outside ndjson/
PUT /studies/{rs}/data/{record} keyed a pseudonym in upper case while every other route keys it in lower case, so its values went to another record
the audit report file (report.csv) skipped the page's pseudonym rule (D-380, D-771): a disclosure lookup's line showed the pseudonym
csrf_ok raised in hmac.compare_digest on a submitted value with non-ASCII text (a 500 instead of the refusal)

SMTP (outbound.py) and IMAP (gateway.py) passed no TLS context, so the certificate and host were never verified (CERT_NONE); built on the owner's option 2: verified by default, a per-server switch to off, each start with it off or without TLS audited, the install check tests the certificate

the platform manifest trusted X-Forwarded-For from every sender (--forwarded-allow-ips *) and compose trusted only 127.0.0.1 behind Caddy (V3-01); built on the owner's option 3: one named list, Caddy's fixed address on a box, the site's range on a cluster, all refused in PRODUCTION, a doctor line
edc.sent writes opted_out: n beside one named record, so n = 1 says that patient opted out (D-147)
phi_guard's twelve-digit pattern misses a number in fours joined by two spaces or by an underscore
the console mails the job of an account with no mailbox to the administrator's mailbox (D-280); what the mail holds per job type is not verified
the prefill quote check still takes an integer as shown by a longer number holding it (7 by a quote saying 70)
